Hi Jon / Greg (cc'd),

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the deep dive on Medicore's regulatory and network constraints. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

Summary from today's call:
- Medicore is evaluating a private deployment for production PII workflows; HIPAA and GDPR are in-scope.
- Primary concerns: network isolation, key management, audit logs, and the ability to operate in a semi-air-gapped environment for specific facilities.
- Timeline: procurement review scheduled early May; security review expected to take 2-3 weeks after we provide the questionnaire and topology diagrams.

Immediate next actions (proposed):
1) We will send our vendor security questionnaire and a reference deployment diagram (VPC and on-prem examples). (I attached the post-call deck for context.)
2) Medicore to confirm current SOC 2 status and any existing gaps related to data residency / HIPAA controls.
3) Schedule a technical walkthrough between Medicore's infra/security and our infrastructure eng (Rishi) to walk through the network and firewall requirements.

Notes on topology options we discussed:
- Private VPC (managed): redwood control plane in our secure tenancy, data plane in a customer VPC peered via transit or PrivateLink. Good for predictable ops and simpler upgrades.
- Dedicated on-prem / air-gapped: full customer-managed network, optional physical air-gap. This option requires additional onboarding and our hardened on-prem checklist (we'll share this).

Attachments: postcall-deck.pdf (high level), we'll follow with the vendor_questionnaire and deployment diagram in the next email.

Could you confirm who from Medicore will be the point for SOC/HIPAA evidence and whether Legal Ops should be included on the questionnaire exchange?

Thanks,

Neha, thanks — good summary. A few quick answers from my side: 

- SOC 2: we are currently SOC 2 Type II in progress; final report expected Q3. We can provide our in-flight controls matrix now and share anything finalized as it becomes available.
- HIPAA: yes, PHI workflows are in the scope for the product we discussed. We need clear assurances on audit logging and KMS options (customer-managed keys preferred).
- GDPR: the EU data residency requirement applies for a subset of our EU customers; we'll need advice on routing and regional deployment.

I've attached our current compliance matrix for reference (medicore-current-compliance-matrix.xlsx). Please send your vendor questionnaire and any template deployment diagrams — Greg (CISO) will want to review the network ports, ingress/egress, and hardware isolation options.

Jon / Greg — attaching the initial vendor security questionnaire (vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf) and a reference deployment diagram (redwood_private_deploy_diagram_v3.png). A few clarifying notes that should help your security reviewers: 

1) Vendor questionnaire: answerable in two passes — a high-level pass for procurement (controls and certifications) and a technical pass for infra (ports, subnets, IAM). We've marked questions we commonly see cause follow-ups.

2) Deployment topologies in the attached diagram:
   - "Managed Private VPC" shows the control plane in our multi-tenant control plane with dedicated data plane in an isolated customer VPC (recommended if you want quicker turn-up + upgrades).
   - "Customer On-Prem / Air-gapped" illustrates a fully customer-controlled network with optional one-way data export for reporting. For air-gap scenarios we normally:
      * Deploy the inference runtime into customer-controlled GPU hosts behind an internal-only network segment.
      * Use offline artifact transfer (signed image tarballs) or an ops box with tightly scoped egress to pull approved images.
      * Provide a hardened checklist (I flagged the checklist items below for Rishi to expand).

3) KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations. If you need HSM-backed signing in on-prem, we'll map the key flows in the technical walkthrough.

Next steps I propose: 
- Medicore to complete the initial vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf (high-level answers) within 5 business days.
- Rishi to run a short hardened-onprem checklist and share by EOD 2026-04-14.
- Schedule a 60-min technical walkthrough with Greg and your infra team the week of Apr 20 — I'll share a few suggested slots.

Rishi — can you own the checklist and the walkthrough prep? Laura, looping you for procurement alignment and to own the HubSpot deal updates.

Best,
